title: Dickens's Hidden Lesson
coreMove: Audit the hidden costs of a desire before treating achievement as the same thing as fulfillment.
sourcePressure: The late-book turn shifts from decision quality to value quality: what matters, hidden costs, miswanting, fulfillment, and whether pursued outcomes are worth wanting.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Literary analysis, anti-ambition sermon, or moral theory instead of practical examination of wanting.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'

exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
